description: Heavy-duty PETG two-pedal wedge for clip-free Type B1 top plates. Each plate slides horizontally from its outside edge into a dovetail lane, stops at the 10 mm centre ridge, and is retained by a captive centre-top hex screw. The wedge itself uses two integral QuickMount clips to engage the RockBoard.

plate.note: The top plates retain the signed-off B1 screw field with the normal board clips removed, but their lobed outline is cleaned up to a 72 x 125.5 tangent rounded rectangle.

deck.note: The 125B plates use the existing 20/40/135 inclined reference placement; their +Y close hole rows ride toward the tall end.

layout.note: The 10 mm clear gap is between the 72 mm B1 plate outer edges. The centre ridge occupies that gap and is the inward hard stop for both plates.

dovetail.note: Each plate has three rails running across X, the plate insertion direction: two smaller rails moved toward the two short 72 mm plate edges at Y = +/-44, and one wider centre rail. The female lanes are undercut grooves in the wedge deck, open only at the outer edge and blocked by the uncut centre material. Clearance is per flank for PETG sliding fit.

pressure_lock.note: One broad PETG cantilever under each exterior centre rail. The plate's outer-end underside has a shallow notch; it depresses the tab's ramp during insertion, then the 1.1 mm catch springs into that notch after the plate reaches the centre stop. The tab prevents outward slide only; the three dovetail rails and centre stop carry pedal load.

structure.note: The wedge is a closed heavy-duty shell with 4 mm walls and cross ribs. The deck skin is 4 mm; dovetail roots, uncut centre stop material, and board-clip roots are solid-wall load paths rather than infill-dependent features.

board_clips.note: Four proven B1 retainer sections, arranged as two pairs, are fused under the base. The wider spread distributes load and gives more usable RockBoard placement choices; their mouths are freed by closed windows and the clips face outward.

lightening.note: Two stadium recesses per outside face remove material while retaining a 2 mm PETG skin, 4 mm edge walls, and uncut load paths around the clips and dovetail roots.

fabrication.print_orientation: base plate on the bed; the board clips face down and need local supports only under their arches
fabrication.infill: 25-40 percent gyroid or honeycomb after confirming the dovetail coupon; walls, rails, ridge, and clip roots must remain solid
